title: Omilia raises $67M to scale its customer support platform
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The Series B is the company's second fundraise since it last raised capital in 2020. In that time, it has increased its ARR by 10x to $60 million.
body:
### Announcement and Funding
Omilia, a company specializing in automating customer support, has secured $67 million in Series B funding led by Expedition Growth Capital. This investment will enable the company to scale its customer support platform, which has already shown significant growth, with a 10x increase in annual recurring revenue to $60 million since its last funding round in 2020.

### Technology and Approach
Omilia's approach to customer support automation differs from other startups in the industry. Instead of relying solely on AI, the company uses a combination of tools to handle customer queries efficiently. Its self-learning agents can work across various customer contact points, providing basic information such as account balances without the need for large language models. This pragmatic approach allows Omilia to offer great unit economics for both itself and its customers.

### Impact and Future Plans
The funding will help Omilia expand its operations and build on its existing client base, which includes notable companies like Capital One and Taco Bell. With a focus on quick-service restaurants and voice-based ordering, Omilia is well-positioned for growth in the customer support industry. The company's goal is to achieve $1 billion in revenue within the next three years, prioritizing steady growth and strong foundations over flashy technology.
